capabilities: Correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation in selected text
Run corrections on whole notes or multiple Markdown files
Review highlighted corrections with batch stop and retry
Manage a Constance account and buy credits in settings
disambiguation: Not limited to spelling; it also rewrites grammar and punctuation, and includes account and credit purchasing.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. Account requests send authentication and billing data to Constance; error reports go to Datadog and may include file paths or content. There is a free allowance; pricing is verified at purchase time in USD via Paddle.
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellcheck flags errors but doesn't apply grammar and punctuation corrections across selections, notes, or multiple files.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.
New purchases use Paddle and USD.

summary: AI spell corrector that fixes spelling, grammar, and punctuation in selected text, notes, and Markdown files via OpenRouter.
